title: IronPay (with SDK)
tagline: "IronPay: Empowering merchants with seamless integrations! Create a payment gateway with IronfishButton, effortlessly manage their online store, and gain insights into product sales and revenue. Seamlessly bridge between Sepolia and Ironfish testnet for secure transactions."

prizes.placement: Best use of the Iron Fish protocol with interaction from an EVM chain
prizes.title: Best use of the Iron Fish protocol with interaction from an EVM chain

description: IronPay facilitates merchants and store owners in crafting tailored integrations, granting effortless access to Iron payments on their websites. Through our IronfishButton, merchants seamlessly transfer Iron from Sepolia to Ironfish testnet wallets. Leveraging Ironfish Network's bridge, transactions are secure and swift. Additionally, our merchant dashboard furnishes comprehensive insights into product sales history and total Iron revenue, empowering merchants to make informed decisions.
how_its_made: Utilizing Ironfish's technology, we've developed a seamless bridge between Sepolia and the Ironfish testnet, enabling merchants to accept payments in Ironfish. Our SDK empowers merchants to easily import a button that triggers transactions between spender and receiver. Each merchant can create integrations, integrating our IronfishButton to accept payments in WIRON, with access to transaction history and product purchases.
